children: Overview
Canada oil and gas producer's Q3 total production rose 2% yr/yr to 1,652,000 BOE/d
Net earnings and adjusted net earnings rose sharply from prior year
Company to allocate all free cash flow to share repurchases, targeting C$800 mln per month
Outlook
Company targets $800 mln per month in share repurchases in Nov and Dec 2026
Company to allocate 100% of free cash flow to share repurchases in 2027, subject to market
Company targets Oil Sands Mining and Upgrading production capacity of about 597,000 bbl/d
Result Drivers
THERMAL IN SITU GROWTH - Record thermal in situ production driven by new SAGD and CSS pads at Pike and Primrose
CONVENTIONAL LIQUIDS EXPANSION - Record North America E&P liquids production aided by acquisitions and strong well performance
SULPHUR PRICING - Higher sulphur prices and production contributed to increased revenue in the quarter

The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
